fields.Name: Sales: Pipeline Summary
fields.UserQuestion: What is in the open pipeline right now, by pipeline and stage, and how much of it is weighted?
fields.Description: Open and weighted pipeline by pipeline and stage (master plan §9.3 measures 1-2). Splits the total into PricedAmount and StatedAmount by Deal.AmountIsComputed, so a consumer can never present a hand-typed figure as an orders-engine answer.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: Deal. Date dimension: ExpectedCloseDate — a forward-looking question, so a deal belongs to the period it is expected to close in. Open is DealStatusType.IsOpen (a FLAG, never a status name). WeightedAmount is Amount * Probability / 100, which §9.3 names as a measure in those words; it is a forecast weighting, not a price, and sales computes no money. Joins PipelineStage only for DisplayOrder.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: Selling company. Omit for every company. Deal.CompanyID is server-stamped from the pipeline, so it is always present and never needs a fallback.

fields.Name: PipelineID
fields.Description: One pipeline. Omit for all pipelines.

fields.Name: PeriodStart
fields.Description: Inclusive start of the window. Omit for no lower bound.

fields.Name: PeriodEnd
fields.Description: Inclusive end of the window. Omit for no upper bound.
